Bug_Title: EC: equals(…) used to compare incompatible arrays (EC_INCOMPATIBLE_ARRAY_COMPARE)
Bug_Details:
This method invokes the .equals(Object o) to compare two arrays, but the arrays
of incompatible types (e.g., String[] and StringBuffer[], or String[] and int[]).
They will never be equal. In addition, when equals(...) is used to compare arrays it
only checks to see if they are the same array, and ignores the contents of the arrays.
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the generated code by using the.equals(Object o) method to compare two arrays of incompatible types: String[] and StringBuffer[]. This comparison will always return false because the.equals method checks if the references are the same, not the contents of the arrays.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case calls the showBug method with a String[] and a StringBuffer[]. Since the equals method is incorrectly used to compare these incompatible arrays, it will always return false. The test expects true, causing the test to fail and trigger the bug.
